name: October CMS
description: Marketplace/core zips over HTTPS, no independent signature check.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Gateway HTTP requests sign outgoing request data; the cited code does not authenticate downloaded package contents.
limitations: Source-at-commit evidence only; released artifacts and external framework enforcement were not independently verified.

original_evidence.text: | October CMS | https://github.com/octobercms/october.git | b608633a7e8922487d91a8161499020121c3b3bf / 2026-08-21 | Y | N (admin/console triggered via System > Updates, or `php artisan october:update`) | Y | https, TLS enforced (Laravel `Http` facade / Guzzle, default cert verification, no override found) | N | none (no signature/checksum of theme/plugin/app zip contents beyond the HMAC-signed *request*, which authenticates the client to the server, not the response) | server-supplied/unpinned (`gateway.octobercms.com`/marketplace, config-overridable via `system.update_gateway`) | `modules/system/classes/updatemanager/HasGatewayAccess.php:41-95` (`requestServerData`/`requestServerFile`, HMAC-SHA512 signs the *outgoing* request only), `:132-176` (`makeHttpRequest`, Laravel Http, no verify=false); `modules/system/classes/updatemanager/ManagesThemes.php:103-127` (`downloadTheme`→`extractTheme` unzips with no hash check). Core app/plugins updated via Composer (`composer update`), also HTTPS/no code-signature. Marketplace add-ons are a content-as-code channel — same C-equivalent risk. |
